title: Suspect arrested in Virginia State University shooting that injured five
dek: Camron Harris, a 19-year-old from Henrico, Virginia, was arrested on August 16, 2026, in connection with a shooting at Virginia State University that injured five people. Harris, who is not a student, was found hiding in a dorm closet after the early morning incident. One victim remains in critical condition.
author: The GoCheckMyNews Desk
key_fact: Five people were shot at Virginia State University in the early hours of Saturday, August 16, 2026, with a 21-year-old man in critical condition and four others with non-life-threatening injuries.
bottom_line: Police have arrested a non-student suspect, but investigators have not yet publicly detailed Harris's motive, the charges he faces, or how his arrest reconciles with initial reports of multiple shooters. Court filings and further police statements will clarify those points.
body: Five people were shot at Virginia State University in the early hours of Saturday, August 16, 2026, with one victim in critical condition and four others with non-life-threatening injuries. Camron Harris, a 19-year-old from Henrico, Virginia, was arrested after the incident, according to BBC News reporting.

Harris, who is not a student at the university, was found hiding in a closet on campus following the shooting, police said. Officers responded to the incident outside a residence hall at approximately 1:28 a.m. local time.

According to police, a 21-year-old man remains in critical condition. The other four victims, whose ages range from 17 to 23, suffered non-life-threatening injuries. Only one of the five victims was studying at VSU; the others' connection to the university or campus has not been detailed in available reports.

All five victims were taken to local hospitals with gunshot wounds, per BBC reporting. Chesterfield County Police Lieutenant James R. Lamb initially told the BBC that authorities believed multiple assailants were involved, a discrepancy that remains unresolved in public statements.

The shooting occurred just as Virginia State University was opening dormitories for returning students on Friday, ahead of the start of classes on Monday. VSU, located south of Richmond, is one of the country's historically black universities and has more than 5,000 students.

The circumstances that led police to Harris, his motive, any connection to the victims or university, and the specific charges he faces have not been detailed in available reporting. Questions remain about why initial police assessments suggested multiple shooters despite Harris's solitary arrest.
